thesis: The episode introduces Simon Kold, founder of Cold Constellationen, and his upcoming book on evaluating business quality, which aims to provide a unified framework for assessing business quality through practical day-to-day due diligence rather than just mental models. Kold explains that his writing process evolved from a dry, toolbox-style draft to a more engaging version after incorporating analogies and exaggeration from his stand-up comedy background, a change that was positively received by reviewers.
